name: WhatsApp Lead Receptionist for Driving Schools & Instructors — Instant Reply, Lead Scoring & Hot-Lead Alerts (n8n workflow)
description:
I run a driving school and learners ask about lessons on WhatsApp at all hours — how can every enquiry be answered in seconds, with hot leads flagged?
This is a complete, ready-to-import n8n workflow built for driving schools and independent driving instructors. A customer messages your WhatsApp Business number, and the workflow:
1. Scores the lead — Hot / Warm / Cold — from what they actually wrote (price questions, urgency, the service they name, booking intent)
2. Logs every lead to Google Sheets, so nothing gets lost
3. Emails you instantly when a Hot lead lands
4. Replies to the customer right away — and respects Meta's 24-hour rule, switching to an approved template when the free-form window has closed
Real example, scored live by this exact workflow:
"Hi! I want to book driving lessons and get my license fast. How much is the full course? I can start today, it is urgent, I need the license this month for a new job." → 100 (Hot) → you get an alert, the customer gets an answer.
WHAT'S INSIDE
- The importable n8n workflow (.json), pre-configured for your trade
- Setup guide: live in about 20 minutes, 5 steps, no coding — one CONFIG block holds your business name, hours, timezone and booking link
- Keyword packs in English and Chinese; add your own words in one line each
- MIT license: use it for your own business or for client work
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
The scoring engine shipped in this file was extracted and run through an automated acceptance suite before this listing was written: 7 of 7 checks pass — a hot lead scored Hot with owner alert, a price question scored Warm (60), a bare "hi" kept Cold, delivery receipts ignored, and a malformed webhook safely dead-lettered instead of crashing. The full test log (TEST-RESULTS.txt) is inside the pack.
YOU NEED
- An n8n instance (self-hosted free tier is fine)
- A WhatsApp Business number on Meta's Cloud API (free to register; you bring your own number)
- A Google account for the Sheets log and email alerts
HONEST LIMITS
Scoring is keyword-based — fast, free, predictable — not an AI guess. It is a receptionist, not a CRM. Template approval for after-hours replies is Meta's process; the guide walks you through it.
SETUP SUPPORT INCLUDED
If you get stuck, email support is included: send the node name and a screenshot of the error and get a working answer.
Want it fully done for you instead? The same system is available as a done-for-you build on Fiverr (seller: visionwei).
